info.name: Digital Signage
info.summary: Display digital signage with calendar events and image slideshow
info.description:
Digital Signage displays calendar events from your Nextcloud calendar and images from a folder in a full-screen presentation.
Features: - Calendar events from your Nextcloud calendar - Image slideshow from a Nextcloud folder - Weather information (external API) - Configurable display settings - Public share for display without login
Supported languages: - English (en) - Deutsch (de)
info.author: Lukas Märtin
